d: Frankie is a flared trouser pattern

s.cutBeltLoops.t: The belt loops are not shown
s.cutBeltLoops.d: The **Belt loops** are a rectangular piece of fabric {{{ width }}} wide and {{{ length }}} long that is cut into {{{ count }}} pieces.
s.cutSidePocket.t: The side pocket is not shown
s.cutSidePocket.d: The **Side pocket** is a rectangular piece of fabric {{{ width }}} wide and {{{ length }}} with a fold line {{{ fold }}} from the top and a {{{ pleat }}} pleat width.
s.cutWaistband.d: The **waistband** is a rectangular piece of fabric {{{ width }}} wide and {{{ length }}} with a placket line {{{ placket }}} from the right & a overlap line {{{ overlap }}} from the left.
s.failedPivotOutBack.d: points.pivotOut for back.mjs had to draft with a failsafe method. You may wish to tweak your options to get rid of this message.
s.failedSplitOutBack.d: points.splitOut for back.mjs had to draft with a failsafe method. You may wish to tweak your options to get rid of this message.
s.failedPivotOutFront.d: points.pivotOut for frontBase.mjs had to draft with a failsafe method. You may wish to tweak your options to get rid of this message.
s.failedSplitOutFront.d: points.splitOut for frontBase.mjs had to draft with a failsafe method. You may wish to tweak your options to get rid of this message.
s.sidePocketPleatNoFold.d: When Side pocket pleat is enabled, Side pocket folded is disabled.

waistHeight.d: Controls the height of the waist, 100% = waist height, 0% = hip height

lengthBonus.d: Controls the length of the trousers

crotchDrop.d: Lowers the crotch for a more relaxed fit

legBalance.d: Controls the ratio between front and back panel of the leg

crossSeamCurveStart.t: Start of the cross seam curve
crossSeamCurveStart.d: Controls how far into the cross seam we start to curve

crossSeamCurveBend.d: Controls the curvature of the cross seam

crossSeamCurveAngle.d: Controls the angle of the cross seam

crotchSeamCurveStart.t: Start of the crotch seam curve
crotchSeamCurveStart.d: Controls how far into the crotch seam we start to curve

crotchSeamCurveBend.d: Controls the curvature of the crotch seam

crotchSeamCurveAngle.d: Controls the angle of the crotch seam

seatEase.d: Controls the amount of ease at your seat

waistBalance.d: Controls the horizontal position of the waist relative to the seat

waistEase.d: Controls the amount of ease at your waist

waistAngle.d: Change the angle of the waistband when viewed from the side

useWaistAngleFor.d: Apply the waistband angle to the front, back or both

useWaistAngleFor.both.d: Apply the waistband angle to the front and back

useWaistAngleFor.backOnly.d: Apply the waistband angle only to the back

useWaistAngleFor.frontOnly.d: Apply the waistband angle only to the front

grainlinePosition.d: Controls the horizontal position of the leg relative to the seat

beltLoopDoubleFolded.d: Controls whether the belt loop has to be folded in half or not.

beltLoopDoubleFoldedNo.d: The belt loop does not have to be folded in half.

beltLoopDoubleFoldedYes.d: The belt loops has to be folded in half.

beltLoopNumber.d: Controls how man belt loops to include.

beltLoops.d: Controls whether to draft belt loops or not.

beltLoopWidth.d: Controls the width of the belt loops.

buttonholePlacket.d: Controls whether the fly is drafted with a buttonhole placket.

buttonholePlacketNo.d: The fly is drafted without a buttonhole placket.

buttonholePlacketYes.d: The fly is drafted with a buttonhole placket.

buttonholePlacketNum.d: Controls the number of buttonholes the buttonhole placket is drafted with.

crossSeamSaWidth.d: Multiplies the cross seam seam allowance.

crotchSeamSaWidth.d: Multiplies the crotch seam seam allowance.

flyLength.d: Controls the length of the fly.

flyShieldCurved.d: Controls whether the fly shield is drafted curved or not.

flyShieldCurvedNo.d: The fly shield is drafted without a curve.

flyShieldCurvedYes.d: The fly shield is drafted with a curve.

flyWidth.d: Controls the width of the fly.

frontPocketBagSaWidth.t: Front pocket bag seam allowance width
frontPocketBagSaWidth.d: Multiplies the Front pocket bag seam allowance.

frontPocketBagDepth.d: Controls the depth of the front pocket bag.

frontPocketDepth.d: Controls the depth of the front pocket bag.

frontPocketFacingWidth.d: Controls the width of the front pocket bag facing.

frontPocketOpeningDepth.d: Controls where the front pocket opening starts.

frontPocketOpeningLength.d: Controls the length of the opening for the front pocket.

frontPocketsBool.d: Controls whether to draft front pockets.

frontPocketWidth.d: Controls the width of the front pocket bag.

hemWidth.d: Controls the width of the hem allowance.

inheritFrontPocket.d: Controls whether the front pocket bag inherits seams from the front legs

inheritFrontPocketNo.d: The front pocket does not inherit seams from the front leg.

inheritFrontPocketYes.d: The front pocket does inherit seams from the front leg.

legCurve.d: Controls the tightness of the leg curves.

legFlare.d: Controls the angle used to draft the leg flare.

legFlareBalance.d: Controls the distribution of the flare between the side and inseams.

legFlareHeight.d: Controls where the flare is drafted on the leg. 100% is at the knee.

legFlareLock.d: Controls whether the sideseam flare is locked to below the fork or can travel up to the waist.

legFlareLockNo.t: Allow the side seam to travel past the fork
legFlareLockNo.d: The side seam flare can travel to the waist.

legFlareLockYes.t: Lock the side seam flare below the fork
legFlareLockYes.d: The side seam flare is locked below the fork.

legFlareSplit.d: Controls where to start the split for the leg flares.

sidePocketDepth.d: Controls the depth of the side pockets.

sidePocketFolded.d: Controls whether the side pocket is drafted by folding in half or the top is folded down.

sidePocketFoldedNo.d: The side pocket is drafted with a top down fold.

sidePocketFoldedYes.d: The side pocket is drafted to fold in half.

sidePocketFoldLength.d: Controls the length of the fold at the top of the side pocket.

sidePocketPlacement.d: Controls the placement of the side pocket along the side seam.

sidePocketsBool.d: Controls whether to draft side pockets.

sidePocketWidth.d: Controls the width of the side pockets.

sideSeamSaWidth.d: Multiplies the side seam seam allowance.

titanGuide.d: Whether to show the underlying Titan block Frankie is based on.

waistbandCurved.d: Whether the waistband is drafted straight or curved.

waistbandFolded.d: Whether the straight waistband is drafted with a fold.

waistbandFoldedNo.d: The straight waistband is drafted without a fold.

waistbandFoldedYes.d: The straight waistband is drafted with a fold.

waistbandOverlap.d: Controls the overlap width of the waistband.
